purpose: Check correlation between proposed OpenTelemetry GenAI tool-call decision events and execute_tool spans without inferring external-effect confirmation.

invariants.rule: Missing tool-call correlation identity is UNRESOLVED_CORRELATION, never inferred from local row ids or timestamps.
A deny decision and an observed execute_tool span sharing the same tool-call id is a contradiction.
A require_approval -> allow lifecycle sharing one tool-call id may correlate to one observed execute_tool span; more than one observed execution is a duplicate-execution contradiction.
The absence of an execute_tool span is only absence of observed execution, not proof that no external effect occurred.
Correlation completeness does not establish authorization correctness, durable effect, or authoritative external-effect confirmation.
